notes.claim: A rate with a denominator of 1 is called a unit rate.
Specific fuel oil consumption for marine engines is given in g/kWh, a rate of fuel mass per unit of energy (MAN Energy Solutions project guide).
A consultancy page puts marine specific fuel consumption between 155 and 225 g/kWh at optimal load (a blog figure, not a maker's).
Specific fuel consumption is not constant: it rises greatly at low power, so the g/kWh rate holds only near steady load.
